channel.title: CIS 643 - Software Engineering Project II :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description Continuation of CIS 642. Final implementation, integration, and testing of a software system. Introduction to configuration management, project management, and software maintenance. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Overview Not yet drafted — pending course-designer’s detailed pass. resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md lists this as one of three choices (with CIS 598, DEN 591) for the Year 4 Capstone. Note the prerequisite below (CIS 642, taken the preceding semester) isn’t itself in the current core’s Year 3–4 elective structure as documented — worth confirming this pathway is actually reachable under the redesigned map before treating it as a settled capstone option.
